Invite someone close: they will see the phase and the period forecast and get ideas on how to be supportive. You decide what is shown.
Data is encrypted on the phone. The key travels only inside the invitation, so the server cannot read it.
The partner link has ended. The shared data was deleted.
Your partner can scan the QR code with their phone camera and open the link in Twilight Cycle. Or send the code: it goes into Settings, under Partner mode. The code works once and for one day.
The code holds the encryption key. Showing the QR code in person is safest: a sent message stays in the chat. Do not post the code anywhere.
This code came from a link. Connect only if someone you know invited you.

Compare this code with the one on your partner\'s phone (Settings → Partner mode). Nothing is shared until you confirm. If the codes differ or your partner has not joined yet, unlink and invite again.

resources.string: Today is in the fertile window.

string-array.name: partner_tips_menstrual
string-array.item: Ask how you can help, and just be there.
Take on some of the chores.
Warm tea, a heating pad or a favourite meal often help.
Wanting quiet and rest is normal; do not take it personally.

string-array.name: partner_tips_follicular
string-array.item: Many people have more energy these days: a good time for plans together.
Suggest a walk, sport or trying something new together.

string-array.name: partner_tips_ovulatory
string-array.item: Many people feel especially sociable and confident these days.
A good time for a date or meeting friends.

string-array.name: partner_tips_luteal
string-array.item: Closer to the period, tiredness and mood swings are common. Be patient.
Help lighten the schedule and leave time to rest.
A cosy evening in and something tasty often cheer people up.

resources.string: The forecast is approximate. It is not medical advice and not a method of contraception.
A gift can be given once every %1$d days.
Nothing to give right now: the pet has everything available.
Food and gifts travel encrypted and reach the pet once your partner\'s phone is online. A gift arrives if the pet does not have it yet.
